query:
SELECT  i.inv_id, i.full_name, COUNT(*) AS active_awards,
       SUM(a.total_amount) AS active_award_total, MAX(a.end_date) AS latest_end
FROM award a
JOIN award_investigator ai IGNORE INDEX FOR JOIN (PRIMARY, fk_ai_inv) ON ai.award_id = a.award_id
JOIN investigator i IGNORE INDEX FOR JOIN (PRIMARY)         ON i.inv_id    = ai.inv_id
WHERE a.inst_id = @inst_id AND a.start_date <= @today AND a.end_date >= @today
GROUP BY i.inv_id, i.full_name
ORDER BY active_award_total DESC
LIMIT 25
